definitions.explanation: Imaginative thoughts or ideas that are not based in reality; fanciful thinking.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}の{頃|ころ}は{空想|くうそう}の{世界|せかい}で{遊|あそ}んでいた。
examples.english: As a child, I played in a world of fantasy.

examples.japanese: {空想|くうそう}{科学|かがく}{小説|しょうせつ}が{好|す}きだ。
examples.notes: {空想|くうそう}{科学|かがく}{小説|しょうせつ} = science fiction (SF)

examples.japanese: {空想|くうそう}にふけっていたら、{時間|じかん}が{経|た}っていた。
examples.english: While lost in daydreams, time passed.

notes:
{空想|くうそう} refers to imaginative or fanciful thinking disconnected from reality.

Common expressions:
- {空想|くうそう}にふける (to be lost in fantasy/daydreams)
- {空想|くうそう}{科学|かがく}{小説|しょうせつ} (science fiction)
- {空想|くうそう}の{世界|せかい} (fantasy world)
- {空想|くうそう}{家|か} (dreamer, fantasist)

Related terms:
- {想像|そうぞう} (imagination - more general)
- {妄想|もうそう} (delusion - more negative)
- ファンタジー (fantasy - loanword)
- {夢想|むそう} (reverie, daydream)

Usage note:
{空想|くうそう} can be neutral or slightly negative (impractical dreaming), whereas {想像|そうぞう} is neutral.
